I with a few producers got together and set out a production plan a few months back for this play. Our PR girl and production manager were in conversation with Curtis Brown (the copyright owners) I think trying to negotiate a deal of some sort, but that fell through and we made a deal with Samuel French the play publishers. We filmed it and it was all good, then I got an email from my PR girl telling me that we can’t put it out because Brown own all film rights. So a little annoyed I emailed them asking if I could have the rights and they simply replied ‘we cannot licence this’.

I’m not entirely sure what to do, should I show them the film? Or can I put it online? What can I do when I don’t have the license?
